name: Data Analyzer: The Export section appears as soon as an analysis completes
objective: Proves the user does not need an extra click or reload to see the export controls after running an analysis.
precondition: Web page loaded in the offline test harness. No network: the AI dictionary reader is replaced by a canned four-field dictionary (gender, pregnant with a valid show-only-if rule, smoker with an invalid show-only-if rule, age as integer with maximum 100), and the page's call to the analysis service is replaced by a canned answer reporting 1 range-violation issue. Private temporary cache folder.

steps.action: Upload a dummy dictionary file and a made-up 2-row CSV (gender Male/Female, pregnant 1/blank, smoker n/n, age 500/30). Check the page before analysing.
steps.expected: No Export heading and no 'Choose format:' selector are shown.
No exception; a success message containing 'Analysis complete' is shown; the Export heading and format selector are shown; exactly one download button exists.

name: Data Analyzer: Excel is the default download and JSON is one selection away
objective: Proves the default format is Excel with highlighting, its download button is visible, and choosing JSON changes the button to a JSON download.
precondition: Web page loaded in the offline test harness. No network: the AI dictionary reader is replaced by a canned four-field dictionary (gender, pregnant with a valid show-only-if rule, smoker with an invalid show-only-if rule, age as integer with maximum 100), and the page's call to the analysis service is replaced by a canned answer reporting 1 range-violation issue. Private temporary cache folder.

steps.action: Upload a dummy dictionary file and a made-up 2-row CSV (gender Male/Female, pregnant 1/blank, smoker n/n, age 500/30). Press Run analysis.
steps.expected: The format selector shows 'Excel with highlighting' and the download button label ends with 'Download Excel'.
The download button label now ends with 'Download JSON'.

name: Data Analyzer: A failed analysis shows its error and does not offer the previous result for export
objective: Proves a user cannot download a stale result after the latest run failed.
precondition: Web page loaded in the offline test harness. No network: the AI dictionary reader is replaced by a canned four-field dictionary (gender, pregnant with a valid show-only-if rule, smoker with an invalid show-only-if rule, age as integer with maximum 100), and the page's call to the analysis service is replaced by a canned answer reporting 1 range-violation issue. Private temporary cache folder.

steps.action: Upload a dummy dictionary file and a made-up 2-row CSV (gender Male/Female, pregnant 1/blank, smoker n/n, age 500/30). Press Run analysis once.
Make the service answer with an error (HTTP 500) and press Run analysis again.
steps.expected: An error containing 'Analysis failed' is shown; the Export section is gone; the stored results are empty; the 'Analysis Summary' heading is not shown.

name: Data Analyzer: The Excel export has Data, Issues and Rule coverage sheets
objective: Proves the Excel file built from the current results contains the three sheets and states that 1 of 2 rules could not be checked.
precondition: No page and no network: the analysis routine is run directly on the made-up table with the service call replaced by a canned answer.

steps.action: Run the analysis on the made-up table and build the Excel file from its results.
steps.expected: The file opens and has sheets named Data, Issues and Rule coverage.

steps.action: Read all text on the Rule coverage sheet.
steps.expected: It contains 'PARTIAL - 1 of 2 rules could not be checked'.

objective: Proves the JSON content matches what the user sees. The test builds the JSON text itself from the stored results rather than pressing the download button.
precondition: Web page loaded in the offline test harness. No network: the AI dictionary reader is replaced by a canned four-field dictionary (gender, pregnant with a valid show-only-if rule, smoker with an invalid show-only-if rule, age as integer with maximum 100), and the page's call to the analysis service is replaced by a canned answer reporting 1 range-violation issue. steps.expected: The JSON parses; its issues-found figure equals the page's 'Issues Found' figure; and its rule coverage reports 1 rule not checked.
